root_cause: Reviewed experiments could only be closed through bg_experiment_actie behind a human token, so reviewed experiments stayed open and produced no learning.
fix: Separate service_role gate that closes ACTIVE experiments with advice: extend at most twice, reject on regression, keep only with a consistent control group.
prevention_rule: A keep decision requires a consistent control group; without it the experiment waits for a human.
terminal_rule: Not terminal until the migration is applied, a caller exists and a first experiment shows besloten_door agent:bg-experimentcyclus in production.
